name: isExternalTargetEncryptionAES256
definition: Every external backup target encrypts stored data at rest with AES-256.
population: the external backup storage targets the integration lists, with their encryption settings
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A target listing in which every target's at-rest encryption algorithm reads AES256.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms. Other backup integrations already emit this key; their meaning is not yet validated against this entry.

notes: Backblaze B2: defaultServerSideEncryption.value.algorithm == AES256 on every bucket; needs the readBucketEncryption capability.
